newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Itron raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Itron raised to buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist raised its estimates and rating on shares of Itron following Itron's report of first quarter sales of $40.6 million and a loss of $0.24/shr, beating its forecast of $34 million in sales and a loss of $0.31/shr.
-- Hambrecht raised its rating to buy from hold. Its 1997 earnings estimate went to a profit of $0.13/shr on sales of $203 million from profit of $0.12/shr on sales of $193.5 million.

-- In a statement, Hambrecht noted Itron's management "projected greater optimism" in a conference call. Also the company's backlog rose sequentially by $30 million to $103 million, and its balance sheet has been strengthened by a debt offer.
